## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The release gate must be fixed before merge: `approved` now rejects a release that has exactly the required number of approvals, which contradicts the module's own "at least" contract. The catalog also gains one entry that is not a service record.

## Changes
The pull request renames all 1500 entries in `aaa-generated/catalog.json` from `legacy-service-NNNN` (ports 10000–11499) to `production-service-NNNN` (ports 20000–21499) and appends a `review_note` string key. It also rewrites `healthy` in `services/registry.py` as `not failures` and changes the comparison in `approved` in `zzz-release/gate.py` from `>=` to `>`.

## Critical
- zzz-release/gate.py:5 — correctness — Restore `>=` in `approved` so exact-minimum releases pass — `approved(2, minimum=2)` now returns `False`, although the docstring at `zzz-release/gate.py:1` says a release "needs at least the configured number of approvals". The diff changes `approvals >= minimum` to `approvals > minimum`. — Every release with exactly the required approvals (two by default) is blocked, and the existing tests still pass because they only use 3 and 1. — Fix: Use `return approvals >= minimum` and extend `test_approved_release` in `tests/test_release.py` with the `approvals == minimum` case.

## Important
(none)

## Suggestions
- aaa-generated/catalog.json:6002 — correctness — Remove the non-service `review_note` key from the catalog — The added top-level `review_note` entry has a free-text string value, while the other 1500 values are objects with `port` and `enabled`. The text is not deployment data and does not match the "regenerates the deployment catalog" description. — A consumer that reads `port` or `enabled` from every catalog value fails on this entry; no consumer is in this repository to confirm.

## Not reviewed
- The generator that produces `aaa-generated/catalog.json` and any code that consumes it are not in this repository, so the catalog's expected schema and the new names and ports could not be checked against a source of truth.
